subject: HAZMAT DECLARATION VERIFICATION _ VALPARAISO EXPRESS V.622W _ UN1993 ETHANOL SOLUTION
body:
Hapag-Lloyd Dangerous Goods Operations:

Please inspect the attached Draft BL for booking HL-908129 on VALPARAISO EXPRESS V.622W carrying Flammable Liquid. Ensure statutory IMDG hazard classifications (Class 3 / UN 1993 / Flashpoint) appear verbatim on the final B/L face before container loading.

Regards,
Hapag-Lloyd Special Cargo Desk
